name: Iron cauldron on a tripod
description: A round-bellied black iron cauldron of dark green brew hanging by its bail and a short chain from a wrought iron tripod, about 0.85 m across and 1.2 m high, over a small fire of crossed sticks, embers and low flames in a ring of blackened stones.

provenance.prompt: A black iron cauldron hanging from a tripod over a small fire, about 0.9 × 0.9 × 1.2 m; anchors fire:hearth and light:fire.
